missionSettings.description: KING OF THE HILL on Ashkara. Nobody holds the island. Two invasion fleets, a fleet carrier and an assault carrier each, stand off opposite shores; aircraft fly from the decks only. One point of control, the Helios Array, has no hangar: land troops, take it and hold it for 8 minutes to win. Every time it changes hands the clock starts again.

missionSettings.description:
WARBOX | Sustained war sandbox on Ashkara

A long combined-arms war with large reserves and no match clock. Brief your flight, choose a role, fly the task, recover and report. Each side holds its airfields with a garrison and keeps a carrier group at sea; its landing craft go for the enemy's airfields by themselves. Take every enemy airfield to win.
